title: Creator Workspace Bridge
description: Stages each stable VPK your tools export and deploys the build you pick to your testing profile.

grants.heading: Workspace
grants.configure: Choose the watched output and a testing profile under Access at the top of this page. This plugin cannot pick files or profiles itself.

watch.missing: No output file yet. Export a build to the watched path.
watch.changing: Output is changing. Staging once it stays unchanged for a few seconds.
watch.waitingForMarker: Waiting for a .ready marker newer than the output.
watch.invalid: The latest output failed validation and was not staged.
watch.idle: Waiting for DMM to check the output.

settings.readyMarker: Only stage after {{marker}} is written. Turn this on if your tool writes the VPK in several passes.

latest.heading: Latest build
latest.empty: No builds staged yet. DMM stages a build after the output stays unchanged and passes validation.

history.heading: Build history
history.empty: Older builds appear here. The deployed build is always kept.

actions.deployHint: Close Deadlock before deploying. Switch to the testing profile to try the build.

status.pending: A deployment is being reconciled with the profile.

errors.artifact_unavailable: DMM no longer holds this staged build. Export it again to restage it.
errors.deploy_interrupted: The previous deployment stopped before it finished. Deploy the build again.
errors.permission_denied: This plugin does not have that permission. Review it under Access at the top of this page.
errors.profile_not_granted: Choose a testing profile for this plugin in DMM before deploying.
errors.state_reset: Saved build history could not be read and was reset.
errors.unknown_build: That build is no longer in history.

access.hint: To watch another file or deploy to another profile, open Access at the top of this page.
